_note: Source of truth for the ElevenLabs agent's client tools. Create each one in the dashboard as type 'Client', with exactly this name, description and parameters, and 'Wait for response' ON. Also enable the built-in system tool end_call.

tools.name: get_seller_snapshot
tools.description: Get the seller's key metrics for last month vs this month: sales, orders, cancellation rate, average selling price, out-of-stock count.

tools.name: get_diagnosis
tools.description: Get the ranked root causes of the seller's sales drop with quantified impact (orders and rupees), evidence, and unknowns: questions only the seller can answer. Call at the start of every call.

tools.name: get_sku_details
tools.description: List up to 5 of the seller's products matching a filter, with stock, status, price, search rank and orders.

tools.name: get_cancellation_breakdown
tools.description: Get this month's cancelled orders counted by reason, compared with last month.

tools.name: get_account_history
tools.description: Get the last call summary, the actions agreed and their status, and follow-up targets versus current numbers. Call at the start of every call.

tools.name: mark_listings_unavailable
tools.description: Mark out-of-stock listings unavailable so new orders stop coming in and getting cancelled. Only call after the seller clearly says yes.

skus.description: SKU codes to mark unavailable, e.g. HK-112

seller_confirmed.description: True only if the seller explicitly agreed to this action in this call

tools.name: set_low_stock_alert
tools.description: Create low-stock alerts that warn the seller when a product has fewer than threshold_days of stock left. Only call after the seller clearly says yes.

threshold_days.description: Alert when stock covers fewer than this many days of sales (3 to 30)

seller_confirmed.description: True only if the seller explicitly agreed to this action in this call

tools.name: create_restock_plan
tools.description: Create a restock task for the seller (owner: seller, due in 3 days), prioritised by lost orders. Only call after the seller clearly says yes.

seller_confirmed.description: True only if the seller explicitly agreed to this action in this call

tools.name: create_deal
tools.description: Create a time-limited discount on one product. Rejected if the discount is over 30 percent or breaks the seller's margin; the response then gives the maximum allowed discount. Only call after the seller clearly says yes.

days.description: How many days the deal runs (1 to 30)

start.description: Start now, or automatically once the product is back in stock

seller_confirmed.description: True only if the seller explicitly agreed to this action in this call

tools.name: update_dispatch_sla
tools.description: Set the seller's committed dispatch time in hours (24 to 72). Only call after the seller clearly says yes.

target_hours.description: Dispatch within this many hours (24 to 72)

seller_confirmed.description: True only if the seller explicitly agreed to this action in this call

tools.name: schedule_followup
tools.description: Schedule a follow-up call with measurable targets. Does not need seller confirmation.

targets.description: Measurable targets, e.g. 'cancellation rate below 9 percent'

tools.name: escalate_to_human_kam
tools.description: Escalate to a human key account manager, who will call the seller within 24 hours. Use if the seller is upset, asks for refunds, compensation or policy exceptions, or the issue is outside your data.

tools.name: save_call_summary
tools.description: Save the call summary to the seller's account. Must be called before ending every call.

actions_agreed.description: Actions agreed or executed in this call

next_steps.description: What happens next and who owns it

follow_up.description: When the follow-up is, e.g. 'in 7 days'
